title: Clause evaluation under agreement
statement: Let $C$ be a clause of literals indexed by natural numbers, and let $a,b$ be truth assignments to the natural numbers. If $a$ and $b$ agree at the variable index of every literal in $C$, then $C$ has the same evaluation under $a$ and under $b$.
hypotheses_covered: The assignments agree on every variable index occurring in the clause
replaced:
Let $C$ be a clause and $a, b$ two truth assignments that agree on the variable
index of every literal occurring in $C$. Then $C$ evaluates identically under $a$
and under $b$.
